appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.fold_tools_help: Reasoning and tool bubbles arrive already closed instead of opening then closing. Click their label to expand them.
appearance.hide_side_help: The sidebar becomes a drawer even on desktop: it stays closed and opens with the ☰ button. Full width for the conversation.
appearance.enter_newline_help: By default, Enter sends the message and Shift+Enter makes a new line. Turn this on to swap them: Enter makes a new line, and Shift+Enter (or Ctrl+Enter) sends.
device.title: Device
config.title: Configuration
presets.title: Presets
agent.title: Agent
agent.enable_help: ⚠ enables machine access (full shell via bash on the server) — the AI can inspect, run scripts, write/read/edit files (30s timeout, 300s max). Memory and internet access below only work if agent mode is enabled.
agent.compact_help: on by default: when the conversation nears the context limit, old turns are automatically summarized (Hermes-style) instead of forcing you to "clear". Near-unlimited conversations without losing the thread.
agent.machines_help: off by default: gives the AI the tools to see machines and switch the machine it acts on, and makes it aware of the procedure to add a machine (which it can do on its own via ssh + ajean remote install). No effect when unchecked.
agent.push_toggle: notify me when the response is ready
agent.push_help: The server sends you a notification at the end of each response, even with the app closed or the phone locked. On iPhone: first add AJEAN to the home screen, then enable it from the installed app. Must be set up on each device.
agent.encrypt_help: Encrypts your memory AND your conversations at rest (AES-256), protected by your access key: if you have access to the interface, it's already unlocked; otherwise you'll be asked for your access key. A recovery key is given to you when you enable it (keep it safe). Nothing is lost: automatic snapshots before every switch.
memory.title: Memory
internet.title: Internet access
internet.help: Adds the web_search / web_open / web_read / web_grep tools. The built-in engine requires no installation. The Crawl4AI engine needs a server you host yourself (e.g. docker run -d -p 11235:11235 --shm-size=1g unclecode/crawl4ai:latest) but it runs pages' JavaScript. Only active if agent mode is on.
internet.crawl_key_placeholder: API key (if the server requires one)
internet.autosave_hint: saved automatically when you leave the field
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.help: Connect MCP servers (Model Context Protocol) to give the AI new tools: file access, databases, business APIs… stdio = program launched locally (npx/uvx/binary) · http = remote server. ⚠ a stdio server runs code on this machine, just like the shell.
mcp.empty_list: (no servers — add a file server, a database, an API…)
tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.pause_help: Master switch: check it so no task triggers anymore. Tasks keep their settings and resume when you uncheck it.
tasks.agent_warn: Agent mode is off: tasks will still run but the AI will have no tools to act with (send an email, read files…). Enable agent mode above.
api.title: API
api.endpoint_help: Point any OpenAI-compatible client (OpenCode, Continue, Cursor…) at these addresses. If a key is set, the client must send Authorization: Bearer <key>.
api.lan_help: Off, the engine only listens on this machine: the address above only responds here. Turn it on to connect software from another computer on the network (on Windows, the firewall rule is set at the same time). Restarts the engine.
api.public_help: Makes your AI reachable from anywhere via https://<machine>.oai.ajean.link/v1 (to connect a SaaS). Traffic is encrypted end-to-end to this server — the ajean.link relay sees nothing. Requires remote access to be on.
api.public_address_label: Public address — end-to-end encrypted, accessible everywhere
api.key_help: Protects the completions endpoint (llama-server). Essential before exposing the server to the internet. Changing the key restarts the service.
link.title: Link
link.remote_help: Access this AJEAN server from anywhere, with no port forwarding, through the ajean.link relay. Traffic is encrypted end-to-end: the relay sees nothing. Subscription €4.80/month.
link.remote_off_desc: Open remote access to this server in a few clicks, no terminal needed.
link.first_connection_help: The first time you open the remote portal, confirm the fingerprint and enter the pairing code: this locks the black box to THIS server (anti-interception). Only needed once per device.
link.backup_help: Backs up your memory, presets, and settings to ajean.link. Everything is encrypted on your server before being sent: the relay only sees an opaque blob, unreadable even if it were hacked. Restorable to a fresh server with your backup password.
engine.title: Engine
engine.mode_fast_desc: official binary downloaded as-is, ready in ~2 min
engine.mode_opt_desc: compiled here for your machine — faster, longer to install
engine.mode_custom_desc: a llama.cpp fork for special models (ternary quant…)
engine.service_help: Starts, restarts, or stops llama-server — the process that loads the model and responds. Restarting reloads the active preset's model (a few seconds to a few minutes depending on its size).
